name: Spectrum Cleaners
about: Dry cleaning and alterations on West Broad Street in Falls Church. Customers return for friendly service, careful garment care, and help with the fit of their favorite clothes.
address: 450 W Broad St Ste 130, Falls Church, VA 22046

reviews.author: Thi L.
reviews.text: I have been going here for almost 2 years to get my husband’s dry cleaning done and the price, quality and speediness is unbeatable.

reviews.author: Wi
reviews.text: I needed my dress fitted as it was too loose for an upcoming photography shoot. She was able to get it hemmed and the shoulders fixed.
